title: comm-decision-record template variables
description: Values for templates/comm-decision-record.md.j2 and templates/comm-decision-record.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from comm-decision-record.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: What fires a page on this call, and at what threshold? Tie each threshold back to the latency budget above rather than picking a round number.

alternative_1.title: Alternative 1
alternative_1.description: What was the first alternative considered, and why was it rejected? The rejection reason is the part a future reader needs when the constraints change.

alternative_2.title: Alternative 2
alternative_2.description: What was the second alternative considered, and why was it rejected?

call_name.title: Call name
call_name.description: Which call does this ADR decide? One call per record - a record covering "everything between checkout and billing" cannot be reversed one call at a time.

caller.title: Caller
caller.description: Which service initiates this call? Name the service as the catalogue names it, not the team that owns it.

communication_style.title: Communication style
communication_style.description: Which style is chosen? This is the decision the whole record exists to record, and every field above is the evidence for it.

dedupe_mechanism.title: Dedupe mechanism
dedupe_mechanism.description: How does the server recognise a key it has already served? A key nobody checks is decoration.

downstream.title: Downstream
downstream.description: Which service or services are called? List every one - a second consumer discovered later is what turns a REST call into an event nobody planned for.

durability_required.title: Durability required
durability_required.description: Must this message survive the downstream being down - is losing it unacceptable? Yes forces a broker with persistence; no permits fire-and-forget.

fan_out_consumers.title: Fan out consumers
fan_out_consumers.description: How many independent consumers need this event? One means a direct call is honest; three or more is the argument for async that the rest of this record is downstream of.

idempotency_mechanism.title: Idempotency mechanism
idempotency_mechanism.description: How does the caller mark a retry as the same request? Without one of these a retry is a second order, and retries are not optional.

latency_budget_ms.title: Latency budget ms
latency_budget_ms.description: How many milliseconds may this call take at p99 before the caller breaks its own promise? The budget, not the current measurement.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Which metrics does this call emit? Name them, because an alert can only fire on a series that exists.
metrics.default: histogram of latency, counter of failures by code

p99_downstream_ms.title: P99 downstream ms
p99_downstream_ms.description: What is the downstream's own measured p99 today, in milliseconds? If it is already above the budget above, synchronous is not on the table.

primary_rationale.title: Primary rationale
primary_rationale.description: What single property decided this - durability, fan-out, latency or type-safety? Name one; a rationale listing four reasons is a rationale that fits any decision.

qps.title: Qps
qps.description: How many calls per second at peak, not at average? Peak is what the downstream has to survive, and it is usually the number nobody measured.

retry_policy.title: Retry policy
retry_policy.description: What happens when this call fails? Retrying without jitter is how one slow downstream becomes a thundering herd, so 'none' is a legitimate answer.

schema_registry_url.title: Schema registry url
schema_registry_url.description: Where is this call's schema registered - the URL a consumer resolves at build time? A contract that lives only in a repo is a contract two services can disagree about.

secondary_rationale.title: Secondary rationale
secondary_rationale.description: What is the second reason, the one that would not have been enough on its own?

tracing_propagation.title: Tracing propagation
tracing_propagation.description: How is trace context carried across this call? A boundary that drops the context is where every distributed trace stops being one trace.
